start: Owner of an online gym, gym web pages open for this gym, one plan people can pick, no web page made yet; Get started list

steps.action: Open the set-up step 'Let people find and join your gym online'
user_sees: Subtitle 'Three parts, in order: your free web page, your one link and QR poster, and how people pay.'
Card 1 'Your free web page' with 'MettleUp makes a free web page for your gym at join.mettleup.fit. …'
'Your page is not made yet. Add a few lines about your gym, what it has and some photos, then publish it.'
Buttons 'Make my page' and 'Not now'
'It is your choice. You can turn your page on or off here at any time.'
must_not: A page already shown as on
Part numbers that skip (1, 3)
The step shown for a gym that is not online

steps.action: Tap 'Make my page', publish the page in the editor, come back to this step
user_sees: 'Your page is on. People can open it at {address}.'
Buttons 'Edit your page' and 'Turn off my page'
must_not: The page shown as off after publishing
No way back to this step from the editor

steps.action: In card 2 'Your one link and QR poster', tap 'Copy link'
user_sees: The link in a dashed box
'This is your gym’s one link. It opens your web page on a phone or a computer, and its “Become a member” button opens your join form.'
Toast 'Link copied.'
'✓ You have shared your link.'
must_not: 'Link copied.' when the browser blocked the copy
A link to another gym

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture'
user_sees: The poster with the gym name, QR and link
Toast 'Poster saved as a picture.'
'Print it on A4 and stick it at the desk. On a phone, Print → “Save as PDF” also works. Use the picture for a print shop.'
must_not: A poster whose QR opens a different link from the box
A broken logo mark

steps.action: Read card 3 'How people pay'
user_sees: 'Pay at the gym desk'
'UPI at the desk' with the saved UPI ID, or 'Add UPI ID'
'Pay online when they join' and 'Open Payments' only while online join payments are switched on
'✓ This step is done. You can come back here at any time.'
must_not: 'Pay online when they join' shown while that switch is off
A UPI ID of another gym

start: Owner of an online gym where web pages are NOT open (or this owner cannot edit the page)

steps.action: Open the step
user_sees: Subtitle 'Two parts, in order: your join link and QR poster, and how people pay.'
Card 1 'Your join link and QR poster'
'This is your gym’s one link. People open it on a phone or a computer, pick a plan and send you their details.'
must_not: A 'Your free web page' card
Part numbers starting at 2

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp' (do not send to a real person)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with a ready message carrying the link, with no person picked
'✓ You have shared your link.'
must_not: A message sent by itself
A person picked for the owner

steps.action: Tap 'Print poster'
user_sees: The browser's print preview with the poster only
must_not: The whole panel page in the print
An empty preview on a phone

start: Owner opens the step from somewhere else: a typed address, or the web page editor's way back

steps.action: Type the address of the step in the browser
user_sees: The same step, with the same three (or two) cards
must_not: A blank page
The Get started list instead, for an online gym

steps.action: Tap 'Edit your page', then use the editor's way back
user_sees: This step again, page status as saved
must_not: Back lands on Settings with no way to the step

start: Cases where the step cannot do its job

steps.action: Open the step with no plan that people can pick and no page
user_sees: 'Your join link works once your gym has at least one plan that people can pick. Add one in Plans.'
Button 'Open Plans'
must_not: A link and poster that open a join form with nothing to pick

steps.action: Open the step address on a gym kept in the browser only, or on the demo gym
user_sees: The Get started list opens instead
must_not: A join link for a gym that is not online
A blank page

steps.action: A desk person types the address of the step
user_sees: Nothing of the step is shown
must_not: The link, the poster or the page switch

steps.action: Tap 'Copy link' in a browser that blocks copying
user_sees: Toast 'This browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it.'
must_not: '✓ You have shared your link.' appears

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture' when the picture cannot be made
user_sees: Toast 'Could not make the picture. Try Print poster.'
must_not: 'Poster saved as a picture.'

steps.action: Open the step after MettleUp took the page down
user_sees: In red: 'MettleUp has taken your page down, so visitors cannot see it. Open your page to read MettleUp’s note.'
Button 'Open your page'
must_not: 'Your page is on.'
A 'Turn off my page' button

start: Owner on the step, web page on

steps.action: Tap 'Turn off my page'
user_sees: Sheet 'Turn off your web page?'
'Visitors then see that the page is not here, and links or posters with your page address stop working until you turn it on again. Your one link then opens the join form instead.'
Buttons 'Keep it on' and 'Turn off my page'
must_not: The page goes off before the owner confirms

steps.action: Tap 'Turn off my page' in the sheet
user_sees: 'Turning off…'
Toast 'Your page is off.'
'Your web page is off. Your one link below opens the join form instead.'
'To turn it on, open your page, tick “Show my page to visitors” and save.'
Card 2 is now titled 'Your join link and QR poster'
must_not: Visitors can still open the page
The link box still shows the page address
The words on the page are lost

steps.action: Tap 'Turn my page on'
user_sees: The page editor opens
must_not: The page is switched on without the owner saving it

steps.action: On a gym with no page: tap 'Not now'
user_sees: 'Your web page is off. Your one link below opens the join form instead.'
must_not: The choice is forgotten on the next visit in this browser

steps.action: The turn-off fails (no internet)
user_sees: A red line such as 'Your page could not be turned off. Check your internet and try again.'
The sheet stays open
must_not: 'Your page is off.' shown
The page left half off

start: Owner on the step; a visitor with the link

steps.action: Read what the page and link will show to anyone
user_sees: 'It shows your fees, timings, photos and address. People can send you a question there, or tap “Become a member” to ask to join.'
'It is your choice. You can turn your page on or off here at any time.'
must_not: Member names, phone numbers or money figures on the public page
The page switched on by MettleUp without the owner

steps.action: Turn the page off, then open the page address as a visitor
user_sees: The page is not there
must_not: The old page still open to the public
The gym's photos still served
